d.a: Distribution: found in subalpine mountains in the N. W. corner of Yunnan; also found in mountains of W. Sichuan, Qinghai and southern Gansu, China.
Distribution. Brazil (Espírito Santo and Minas Gerais states).

Distribution and ecology: — Known so far only from Cajamarca, Peru. It grows as an epiphyte in the remnants of the upper montane cloud forest (Figure 2) at an elevation of about 3100 m (Figure 3). Flowering occurs in November. It can be threatened by the expansion of pastures in the region.
Ecuador (Azuay, Canar, Chimborazo, Pichincha, Tunguragua); Peru (Lima, Cajamarca, La Libertad)
